pins.title: Cabin with a Sauna and Hot Tub in Virginia
pins.description: A cedar barrel sauna with a window onto the creek, a hot tub on the patio beside the porch, and a dock to plunge from. Open year round on Virginia's Northern Neck.
pins.altText: The cedar sauna at Captain's Cottage lit by late afternoon sun, creek behind.

pins.title: Waterfront Rental Amenities: Sauna, Dock, Crab Pot
pins.description: What comes with the cottage: a private dock and crab pot, two kayaks and a paddleboard, a cedar sauna, a hot tub, two screened porches, and 103 Mbps for the hours you cannot avoid.
pins.altText: The hot tub on the patio beside the porch, overlooking a Chesapeake creek.

pins.title: A Kitchen That Gets Out of Your Way
pins.description: A gas range, counter space that works, a grill out back, and a window over the sink facing the water. Cook a low boil, eat it on the screened porch.
pins.altText: The green-cabineted kitchen at Captain's Cottage with a window over the sink.
